verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's first-party docs include a "Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide", and the homepage lists "Custom Agent Skills". That points to a documented format for writing your own skills. The pack contains only these titles, though, with no detail on the skill format, how a skill is loaded into a local instance, or any hands-on report of doing it. Missing for 10: documented skill file format/structure, local loading/installation procedure, independent or hands-on corroboration of building and loading a custom skill.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally
